items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 22:1
items.html: The stature of AB that comes out on the Malchut of restriction 1, which is the stature of AVI of Nekudim, which was nullified at the time of the breaking of the vessels, is what is called the thousand worlds sealed with the ring (Alf Almin deChatimin beIzka). For the ring is the aspect of the Mem of Tzelem, which seals the GAR of AB from the aspect of Hochma, and corrects it in the aspect of covered Hassadim, as is known. And it is found that by virtue of the correction of the Mem of Tzelem, made upon the Mochin, this stature of AVI of Nekudim, called the thousand worlds, was sealed and hidden away. And they are called so for the reason of the verse, "and I will teach you [va-alefcha] Hochma," etc. (Vol. 1, p. 323, Item 65).
